name: Spark Energy Minerals Inc.
summary: Spark Energy Minerals Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Canada. It explores for lithium and rare earth elements. The company was formerly known as St. Anthony Gold Corp. and changed its name to Spark Energy Minerals Inc. in January 2023. Spark Energy Minerals Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
